SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).

app_id.description:
The Space's governing App; absent for the server-governed Space (governance
`server`), where levels stop at `moderator`.

channel_ids.description:
The person's full list of private channels in the Space, 0–5,000 distinct ids. Public
channels are open to every member and are not listed (a listed one comes back in
`unknown_channel_ids`).

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

level.description:
The person's level: `member` (`@everyone`), `moderator` or `admin` (the managed roles),
at most the App's `max_level`.
